overview.description: The T-Rex 2X Long Alphabet Daily Target ETF (GOOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Alphabet Inc. stock, less fees, and expenses. GOOX was launched on Jan 11, 2024 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
